patch_description:
The current program collapsed parameters too aggressively, reducing worst_group_margin from 0.34 to 0.25. Prior program 1 achieved 0.34 worst_group_margin with 12 distinct params using:
1. Parity-split RY gates (ry_0 for even qubits, ry_1 for odd qubits)
2. Parity-split RZ rotations (rz_post_even and rz_post_odd)
3. More diverse two-qubit gates (XX, YY, ZZ mix)

This restoration adds modest parameter overhead (from 5 to ~9-10 distinct params) but dramatically improves worst_group_margin and generalization. The parity structure aligns with the underlying symmetry of the problem and provides better expressiveness for hard samples.
